title: CarePlus HIPAA: BAA availability + hosting clearance (follow-up)
content:
['Thanks again for your time this morning — quick recap from the discovery call and proposed next steps.

Highlights from the call:
- CarePlus will process PHI for appointment scheduling and clinical notes ingestion (primary use case).
- You asked for clarity on deployment modes we support that are eligible for PHI: Redwood Private (VPC) and on-prem packaging are the primary options; Dedicated reserved capacity can be scoped for isolated tenancy but requires contractual commitments. Hosted (public API) is not acceptable for PHI.
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent audit period ending 2025). I attached a one-pager and can share the full report under an NDA or secure link.
- BAA: We do provide a BAA for customers processing PHI. Attached is a draft BAA we typically start from; we’ve found small edits are common for procurement teams.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Sara: confirm if CarePlus prefers Private (VPC) or on-prem packaging vs a Dedicated contract by Friday 10/16. This determines networking/KMS approach.
2) Tim / Procurement: please review the attached draft BAA and flag any major changes — we can route to legal for a quick turn.
3) Laura/Karthik (SE/Security): I’m asking you to gather the SOC2 report and a short list of answers for the vendor security questionnaire we discussed (encryption at rest/in transit, key management, logging retention).

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf, Draft_BAA_Template_CarePlus.docx

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20m call if that speeds anything up.

—
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
', 'Thanks Aditya — helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Deployment preference: we are leaning toward Private VPC for the initial pilot, then evaluate Dedicated for production if latency/throughput needs require it. On-prem is possible but would be later in the program due to procurement timelines.

2) BAA: procurement asked that we get a redlined baseline back so they can engage Legal. We will send a request to procurement@careplus.com once we have the draft.

3) SOC2 access: can you provide the SOC 2 Type II report via a secure link? We cannot accept email attachments for the full report. The one-pager is fine to share with stakeholders.

A couple questions for Redwood:
- For Private VPC, do you support customer-managed KMS (we need to bring our own keys)?
- For Dedicated, is there an option to enforce tenant isolation at the infra level (not just logical)?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll coordinate procurement.

—
Sara Bell
VP of Product & Digital Health | CarePlus Health
sara.bell@careplus.com
', 'Sara / team — quick internal note and proposed deliverables: 

Laura: please prepare the following and share via DocSend by end of day tomorrow: 
- SOC2-TypeII-summary-2025.pdf (redacted version we can share externally)
- Short answers to the three PQ items Sara asked about (KMS BYOK, tenant isolation, logging retention) — keep them to 3–5 bullets each.

Karthik: scope the Private VPC offering for CarePlus pilot (expected initial load: ~3M tokens/month, low concurrency). Include options: BYOK via cloud KMS integrations, VPC peering vs private link, and estimated lead time (2–4 weeks post-contract).

I’ll attach the draft BAA and a suggested procurement checklist to the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910. We should also prepare a short SOW template in case procurement asks for timeline/cutover milestones.

Aditya: once you have procurement contact, push the draft BAA and ask for their preferred NDA/secure link for SOC2. Also propose a 30-minute follow-up next week to review answers.

—
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
', 'Thanks all — short update after internal legal/procurement sync at CarePlus. Procurement wants the draft BAA redlineable in Word (sending to procurement@careplus.com) and a DocuSign route if legal approves. They also require: 

- Redacted SOC2 via secure link (DocSend) — CarePlus Security will request access.
- Confirmation that Redwood supports customer-managed keys for Private VPC and a short statement on tenant isolation for Dedicated.

I attached the two files we will push to procurement: Draft_BAA_Template_CarePlus.docx and a link to the one-pager. Laura / Karthik: can you confirm the BYOK and isolation answers in bullet form so I can forward them? I’m proposing a 10/19 10:00am PT 30-minute call to review BAA redline and deployment approach. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign placeholder.

Next steps (summary):
- Redwood: share DocSend link to redacted SOC2 and confirm BYOK + Dedicated isolation bullets (LAURA/KARTHIK).
- CarePlus: procurement@careplus.com will review Draft_BAA_Template_CarePlus.docx and return redlines.
- Schedule 10/19 10:00am PT follow-up call (Aditya to coordinate).

—
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
